author: Marlon Chaviano
name: docs-fumadocs
title: Docs with Fumadocs
description: Documentation with Fumadocs on Next.js: MDX, built-in search, Open Graph images and modern docs components.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Pages are `.mdx` files in `content/docs/`; the sidebar order goes in each folder's `meta.json`.
- Use Fumadocs components (`Cards`, `Tabs`, `Callout`, `Steps`) in MDX.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
